Definition: from G2309; determination (properly, the act), i.e. option:--will.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, thélēsis is the word for will, determination, choice. In Hebrews 2:4, according to his own will.
TheologicalSignificance: Gifts handed out according to God's own will remind me that the Spirit gives as He pleases, not as I would choose.
